source.title: Big Bang Nucleosynthesis: Present Status
source.author: Cyburt, Fields, Olive & Yeh
source.note: Epoch timings cross-checked against Planck 2018 cosmological parameters for recombination and the present age. `display`, `short` and `tick` are editorial labels for the figure — `tick` is the shortened form used where a label must fit above a plotted axis; `t` remains the quantitative value.

rows.label: Planck time
rows.note: Before this, no theory we have applies. Nothing is drawn to the left of it because there is nothing honest to draw.

rows.label: Inflation
rows.note: Space expands by a factor of at least 10^26. Strongly motivated, not directly observed.

rows.label: Matter wins
rows.note: Whatever tipped the balance between matter and antimatter has finished acting by about here. One part in a billion survives.
rows.short: one particle in a billion survives

rows.label: Protons form
rows.note: Quarks bind into protons and neutrons. Every hydrogen nucleus in your body dates from this moment.
rows.short: quarks bind — your hydrogen is made here

rows.label: Neutrinos decouple
rows.note: The universe becomes transparent to neutrinos, and the neutron-to-proton ratio freezes at about one to six.
rows.short: neutrons freeze at one to six protons

rows.label: The deuterium bottleneck breaks
rows.note: Until now, deuterium is destroyed as fast as it forms. Below about a billion kelvin it survives, and nucleosynthesis can finally proceed.

rows.label: It is over
rows.note: Twenty minutes in, the universe is too cool and too thin to fuse anything further. Helium is locked in at about a quarter of all baryonic mass.
rows.short: a quarter of all matter is now helium

rows.label: First atoms
rows.note: 380,000 years. Nuclei capture electrons, the fog clears, and the light released is still arriving as the cosmic microwave background.
rows.short: nuclei catch electrons; the fog clears

rows.label: First stars
rows.note: Around 200 million years. Everything heavier than lithium begins here — nothing in your body except hydrogen existed before this point.

rows.label: The Sun forms
rows.note: 4.6 billion years ago, from gas already enriched by generations of earlier stars.
rows.short: from gas already enriched by earlier stars

rows.label: Now
rows.note: 13.8 billion years. You are reading this.
